title: Finite witness operations under canonical quotient realization
statement: Let l be prime, E/Q_l finite, q:U→V a scheme morphism and n≥0. Put d=pbcIntegralDatum l E and P=d.A/d.I^(n+1) [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Let R_W be pbcDerivedFunctionRealization W d n [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete]. Then the fixed-coefficient witness operations [def-weil-pbc-witness-compatibility] satisfy natural isomorphisms pbcWitnessDirectImage(q,d,n) ⋙ R_V ≅ R_U ⋙ sbcFinitePush(q,n) and pbcWitnessPullback(q,d,n) ⋙ R_U ≅ R_V ⋙ sbcFinitePull(q,n), for the actual finite coefficient operations [lem-sbc-completed-operations-linear-natural-exchange]. No smoothness or constructibility is assumed.

proof.text: Normalize pbcFunctionScalars through the constant-to-function coefficient comparison. Its composite with the canonical finite direct-image ring map equals the pullback of the source constants: transpose sbcFiniteCoefficientIso through the sheaf adjunction, use naturality of homEquiv and its inverse law, then cancel the constant-comparison isomorphism. Thus both coefficient actions on direct-image sections agree.

Restrict module actions to fixed scalars. The identity on each section is linear by the preceding scalar square; these maps commute with restrictions and module morphisms. The module-sheafification unit is an isomorphism on fixed-coefficient sheaves. Cancel the fully faithful scalar restriction functor to obtain realizationDirectImage. Transport the ordinary adjunction across the two realization equivalences; uniqueness of left adjoints gives realizationPullback.

Apply right-derived composition and the exact-equivalence comparison to realizationDirectImage. Identify the witness direct image with the fixed-coefficient derived direct image using finiteCoefficientRealization_directImage and the equivalence unit. Identify witness pullback by cancellation of realization/unrealization units. Derive realizationPullback termwise and compose these isomorphisms to obtain both claimed comparisons.

lean.statement:
theorem sbcFiniteWitnessRealization (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    {U V : Scheme.{u}} (q : U ⟶ V) (n : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (ProEtale.pbcWitnessDirectImage q (pbcIntegralDatum l E) n ⋙
        pbcDerivedFunctionRealization V (pbcIntegralDatum l E) n ≅
      pbcDerivedFunctionRealization U (pbcIntegralDatum l E) n ⋙ sbcFinitePush l E q n) ∧
    Nonempty (ProEtale.pbcWitnessPullback q (pbcIntegralDatum l E) n ⋙
        pbcDerivedFunctionRealization U (pbcIntegralDatum l E) n ≅
      pbcDerivedFunctionRealization V (pbcIntegralDatum l E) n ⋙ sbcFinitePull l E q n)
